item.text:
Introduced [`ActorService`](</Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/R004_module_java/ActorService.java>) to own the simulation’s behavioral update sequence. It now manages the actor registry internally, runs each step’s per-actor update flow, applies plant growth on schedule, removes dead actors, unregisters diseases for removed organisms, and adds newly spawned actors plus grass patches. That moves the lifecycle logic out of the simulator and keeps it separate from the coordinate/pathfinding concerns already handled by [`MovementService`](</Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/R004_module_java/MovementService.java>).

[`Simulator.java`](</Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/R004_module_java/Simulator.java>) is now thinner: it advances time and weather, delegates actor progression to `actorService.updateActors(...)`, and publishes state. Reset also goes through `actorService.reset()` rather than directly rebuilding and iterating the actor list. I also removed the now-stale actor-loop helpers and leftover fields from `Simulator`.

Verification: `javac *.java` passed.
